title: `enable_advanced` gate grants unintended pagination to every caller
description: `has_global_access` means 'sees all teams' (true for every member), not 'is admin'. Superuser check bypasses elevated session requirement. Unguarded `.has_global_access` access on potentially-None `organization_context.member` causes AttributeError for non-member tokens.

title: `OptimizedCursorPaginator` uses integer key semantics on datetime column
description: `math.ceil(<datetime>)` raises TypeError. `value_from_cursor` returns int instead of datetime, emitting `WHERE datetime <= <int>` comparison. Endpoint 500s on any audit row. Should subclass `DateTimePaginator` instead.

title: Negative-offset slicing raises ValueError; comment claims opposite
description: Django's QuerySet raises ValueError on negative slice bounds, but comment falsely claims 'Django properly handles negative slicing automatically'. Feature is entirely non-functional.

title: `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result` duplicates base with misaligned comments
description: Lines 845–911 verbatim copy of BasePaginator.get_result; future base fixes are silently missed. Comment at 179–181 says 'allow negative offsets' directly above code that rejects them. Narrative comments restate code without adding information.
